title: Design a Parallel Plate Chassis
shortDescription: Design and fabricate a complete FTC parallel plate drivetrain chassis to explore robot architecture and manufacturing techniques.
deliverable: CAD model, fabricated side plates, and assembled rolling chassis

title: Create a Quick Release Hardware Module
shortDescription: Develop a standardized mounting system that allows robot subsystems to be quickly installed and removed.
deliverable: Working quick-release module, mounting standard, and installation guide

title: Build a Robot Cart
shortDescription: Design and build a competition-ready cart for transporting and servicing the robot.
deliverable: Finished robot cart with organized storage for tools, batteries, and parts

title: Build a Linear Slide
shortDescription: Build and evaluate a linear slide mechanism to learn about motion systems, rigidity, and load handling.
deliverable: Working linear slide prototype and performance test results

title: Build a Pollen Intake Prototype
shortDescription: Design and test an intake mechanism capable of collecting and centering game pieces similar to pollen.
deliverable: Working intake prototype and demonstration video

title: Detect AprilTags with Limelight
shortDescription: Use a Limelight camera to detect and track AprilTags for robot localization and targeting.
deliverable: Working FTC code demonstrating AprilTag detection and telemetry output

title: Learn Autonomous with RoadRunner and MeepMeep
shortDescription: Learn to create and simulate FTC autonomous paths using RoadRunner and MeepMeep.
deliverable: Autonomous routine running on the robot and corresponding MeepMeep simulation

title: Create a Sensor Test Suite
shortDescription: Write a robot test program that checks key sensors and reports whether each sensor is connected, reading correctly, and ready for use.
deliverable: FTC OpMode that tests sensors and displays clear telemetry results

title: Analyze Winning FTC Autonomous Routines
shortDescription: Study successful FTC autonomous routines to identify common pathing, scoring, timing, and reliability strategies.
deliverable: Presentation with examples, patterns, and recommendations for Evergreen Dynamics autonomous planning

title: Analyze Driving Techniques from Top FTC Teams
shortDescription: Study elite FTC match footage to identify driving techniques, positioning strategies, and operational best practices.
deliverable: Presentation summarizing key findings and recommendations for Evergreen Dynamics drivers

title: Create a Driver Skills Combine
shortDescription: Design two driving challenges that help team members practice precision, speed, control, and consistency.
deliverable: Two driver challenges, scoring system, and team leaderboard

title: Create an Evergreen Dynamics Team Website
shortDescription: Build a website that showcases the team, its mission, outreach activities, sponsors, and accomplishments.
deliverable: Published team website with core content and navigation

title: Conduct a Branch Out 50/50 Meeting with an FTC Team
shortDescription: Connect with another FTC team to exchange ideas, learn best practices, and strengthen collaboration as part of the Branch Out 50/50 initiative.
deliverable: Completed team meeting, meeting notes, and summary of lessons learned

title: Create Sponsorship Requests for Benton REA and Cadwell Industries
shortDescription: Prepare customized sponsorship request materials for Benton REA and Cadwell Industries that explain the team, funding needs, and community impact.
deliverable: Two sponsor-ready request letters or sponsorship packets customized for Benton REA and Cadwell Industries
